territorial_scope.description: Amends the Texas Election Code, so it applies within the State of Texas.

evidence.quote: Section 255.004, Election Code, is amended by adding Subsections (d) and (e)

summary.short: Texas Election Code amendment creating a criminal offense for a person who, intending to injure a candidate or influence an election result, creates a deep fake video and causes it to be published or distributed within 30 days of an election. Takes effect September 1, 2019.
summary.long: S.B. 751 (86(R) session) amends Section 255.004 of the Texas Election Code by adding Subsections (d) and (e). Subsection (d) makes it an offense for a person, with intent to injure a candidate or influence the result of an election, to create a deep fake video and cause it to be published or distributed within 30 days of an election. Subsection (e) defines 'deep fake video' as a video, created with the intent to deceive, that appears to depict a real person performing an action that did not occur in reality. Section 2 provides that the Act takes effect September 1, 2019. The text states no penalty amount, exceptions or enforcing authority. The Senate passed the bill 31-0, the House passed it with amendment 141-3 with two present not voting, and the Senate concurred in the House amendment 30-0 on May 25, 2019. The governor's approval date line is blank in this document.
